Chief Executive Officer Ben Goodwin will step aside next week and pass the helm of the high-fiber, low-sugar soda maker to an industry veteran from the hydration-beverage brand Electrolit\. Christian Patiño Webb, who has been CEO of Electrolit since 2022, will take over on Aug\. 17, according to Goodwin, Olipop’s cofounder\. He said he’ll stay on as executive chairman of the board and head of innovation as the company scouts for new markets outside the US\.

# Olipop prepares for growth with new CEO OAKLAND, CALIF\. — Functional soda company Olipop has named Christian Patiño Webb as its new chief executive officer to support its next stage of growth\. Patiño Webb succeeds Ben Goodwin, founder and CEO, who is transitioning to executive chairman and head of innovation for the company\. Goodwin, who founded the company in 2018 to support digestive health, will focus on the company’s long-term vision, advance innovation and also shape its next phase of growth while also stewarding its mission, values and culture and will work in partnership with Patiño Webb\. Patiño Webb comes to Olipop from Electrolit, where he most recently was CEO\. During his career, Patiño Webb also has worked for Procter & Gamble, Johnson & Johnson, Red Bull and Unilever\. “Founding and leading Olipop to mainstream success has been the honor of my lifetime, and I feel extremely fortunate and proud of what we’ve accomplished to date,\" Goodwin said\. “The team and I spent significant time carefully selecting a CEO and Christian unequivocally rose to the top\. # Olipop unveils new leadership to support next growth phase Olipop's flavours range from strawberry vanilla to cherry cola \(Image: Olipop\) ## Olipop, the US gut health soda brand, has unveiled a leadership change as it prepares for its next stage of its growth\. The functional beverage brand revealed that Christian Patiño Webb will take over as chief executive officer\. Founder, Ben Goodwin, will step into the role of Executive Chairman and Head of Innovation at the beverage brand\. The brand was founded by Goodwin in 2018 with the mission to reshape the US soda addiction with a healthier alternative\. It has been featured in the Times100s Most Influential Companies in 2024 and it is now in one in five households in the US\. In a Linkedin announcement the company said that Olipop continues to grow in “scale, complexity, and reach” with the appointment of Webb, who has previously worked at Unilever and most recently for Electrolit, the hydration beverage brand, as CEO “marking an important moment in this evolution\.” He will oversee business operations, distribution, organisational execution, brand expansion, and strategic growth initiatives\. # More Americans are starting companies\. Bobbi Brown and other founders share their advice\. Americans filed more than 3 million applications to start businesses in the first six months of 2026, up 16\.5% from a year earlier, according to US Census Bureau data\. The uptick comes as AI lowers the barriers to entrepreneurship, and shifting job requirements and recurring layoffs make some traditional careers feel less secure\. Deepali Vyas, CEO and founder of Vyas Media, told Business Insider that more opportunities are opening up for people to build businesses\. \"Twenty years ago, you probably needed employees and designers and marketers,\" Vyas said\. \"Today, AI can do much of that first draft work\.\" Business Insider spoke to the founders of Jones Road Beauty, PopSockets, Olipop, and OpenFarm about how they built their companies and grew their brands\.
